title: Move embedded body signatures into envelope JWS
description: §13.1.1 says sig is never embedded in a body, but ~20 objects still carry body signature fields: Space state (03), BroadcastKey (03), BanRecord/TimeoutRecord/DMGroupDescriptor? (04), ChannelShareAgreement homeAdminSig/guestAdminSig (08), RelayManifest, RelayAd, SpaceAd, directories, RelayServiceAgreement relaySig/billingSig, AccessChainRegistration billingSig (10), RecoveryAssertion recoverySig and device/admin sigs (02), ComplianceLoggingConfig (07), AgoraMIMICredential (09). Multi-signer objects need the JWS General JSON Serialization (multiple signatures) in the envelope sig; define that in §13.1.1. accessKeyAnnouncement accessSig/billingSig and the sealed envelope sig are separate constructions (see agora-pozi.8, .20.49).
